properties.Caption: Newscopy: "MONORAIL--San Francisco's supervisors are looking ahead to a possible new form of mass transportation - suspended monorail cars high above the street traffic. The board recently authorized the Public Utilities Commission to make an engineering study of the Bilger plan. Shown around a model of the proposed plan are Supervisors Mancuso, Sullivan, McMurray, Anson S. Bilger, president of Suspended Transit Systems, Inc., MacPhee, Christopher and Lewis."  Source: SAN FRANCISCO HISTORY CENTER, SAN FRANCISCO PUBLIC LIBRARY.

Newscopy: "CAB MODEL IN SUSPENDED TRANSIT SETUP--Monorail President Murel Goodell exhibits scale model of cab to be used in pilot line of suspended rapid transit system."  (Exact location conjectural.)  Source: SAN FRANCISCO HISTORY CENTER, SAN FRANCISCO PUBLIC LIBRARY.
